title: Linear response asymmetry between SRB and physical measures for families of intermittent maps with a transition point
summary: We study linear response for families of intermittent maps whose SRB measure undergoes a transition from finite to infinite total mass at a critical parameter value. Our results reveal the following fundamental asymmetry arising from this transition. Smooth parameter dependence of the SRB measure implies continuity of the physical measure at the transition point, while simultaneously precluding its differentiability there.
